title: A Toast Beneath the Moon
description: The Damselette seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall...

mainQuestExcel.title: A Toast Beneath the Moon
mainQuestExcel.description: The Damselette seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogs.text: Oh boy... Even though her eyes are covered, Paimon can tell she's staring right at you.
I... I'd like to try a different drink from the tavern.
Hmm...
So, what do you think?
It reminds me of a time long, long ago, when I was living with the Frostmoon Scions...
The people used to make a kind of tea brewed with fresh mint leaves, spices, and dried berries.
Whenever I passed by their homes, there was always a subtle herbal aroma wafting from the windows...
Did you ever get to try it?
I wanted to, but never got the chance.
Oh, why not...?
When a "Goddess" arrives at your door and asks, "May I try your tea?"... No one dares to offer up the "rustic tea" thrown together for their own consumption...
Ah... Yeah.
What I received in the end was more like an "offering" for the divine, complete with ornate packaging and all.
Not that it tasted bad, per se... But, it was missing that sense of... "home."
Well, now we can fix that!
Mmm...
The flavor is delightful.
...Though I must say, the idea of adding milk seems quite unorthodox to me.
Ah, well this is a Mondstadt recipe. People love adding milk, cream, and sugar to their tea over there.
It's novel... but in a good way.
Phew, glad you like it!
Mm... Thank you.
It seems moonlight is not the only medium through which one can glimpse the past. Even something as simple as the aroma of a drink can bring back long-forgotten memories...
Hm, I've smelled something like this before.
Oh, really? Where?
In Sandrone's room. She had a drink that smelled like this. The aroma caught my interest, and when she noticed... she just held on to the drink for ages without finishing it.
It was like... she was waiting for me to ask about it.
So... did you?
Yes.
What did you ask?
Shouldn't you be drinking engine oil instead?
And... how did she respond?
Um...
She said something quite unpleasant. It doesn't bear repeating.
You lost interest after a single sip!?
Sorry, it was a little bitter... all in all, not very good. No wonder Sandrone looked so sour when she drank it.
Paimon thinks there might've been other reasons for that...
*glug*... *glug*...
Wow, that was quick! Looks like she loves it!
Hm... completely flavorless.
F—f—flavorless!?
Yes.
Maybe you drank it too fast...
Oh... Thanks, but no need.
There was a time when I failed to understand why people felt such joy at harvest time. Then, one day, I reached out to touch a piece of ripe fruit hanging from a branch...
I sensed vitality in the very texture of its skin — the organic embodiment of sunlight, water, earth, and air.
With each bite, I felt a refreshing sweetness surge over me like waves of cool white foam.
And that's how I came to understand the irresistible power of aroma.
Oh, that's interesting!
Then, we complete nature's cycle by taking that life force for ourselves.
Uhh, that suddenly turned kinda dark...
That is why I prefer fresh fruit. It allows me to see what I took from this world, exactly as it was before I took it.
And reminds me of what I owe this world in return...
Why don't I make you another one?
This one is delicious!
It's my favorite so far.
Wow! Finally, a drink that Columbina likes! Paimon's over the moon...
Uhm... sorry?
Let's summarize: No noticeable bitterness, never add fruit juice straight, and milk's okay but it's better without...
So this is a "lighter-bodied" drink...
Figuring out the pattern's a good thing! In the future, we'll know how to mix drinks the way you like 'em.
...In the future?
Of course, we're friends! Whenever you're feeling thirsty, you just let us know!
Wait, is that why you aren't finishing your drink? You're not saving it because you think this is the last cup you'll ever taste, are you?
...Uhm.
It's fine, don't worry.
Thanks for the treat.
Here, try it for yourselves. This Lakkaberry is very sweet, so make sure you savor it.
In the future... I'll be sure to let you know.
Well... Thank you for satisfying my curiosity. I'll be sure not to trust Sandrone's taste ever again.
Perhaps you could make something for me again in the future?

questNarration.text: Mmm, it smells so fresh! Columbina's gonna love this, for sure!
Wow, even Paimon wants to try a glass of that...
Wow, this smells amazing! Wonder if Columbina has ever had something like this before...
A light, refreshing drink. Paimon's sure she's gonna love this one!
I seem to have made a mistake somewhere... Let me try again.
